title: Verdict and Cipher
author: Lena Okonkwo
blurb: Hazel Lockridge, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
